status: pre-registered before any model training or test evaluation
primary_metric: user-macro HR@8 on rule R0, main group (visible history >= 5), queries with more than 8 candidates, full-catalogue candidate ranking
validation_use: A1 weight, GBDT / two-tower hyper-parameters, early stopping and the pre-selection of the candidate to deploy use validation users only; test users are evaluated once, after freeze

order: lower complexity (A1 < B0 < B1 < C0; fewer trees x leaves)

a1.rule: highest validation HR@8; within the margin: higher NDCG@8, then the weight closest to 0.15, then the smaller weight

trial_selection: per model family: highest validation HR@8 (training seed 42); within the margin the tie-break order above
pre_selection: the candidate to deploy is the family with the highest validation HR@8 among A1, B0, B1, C0 (learned families: mean over training seeds); within the margin the tie-break order above
conservative_fallback: A1 (validation-tuned formula; identical to A0 when the chosen weight is 0.15)
deployed_artifact: training seed 42 of the pre-selected family; its own test metrics are reported next to the seed mean and decide the confirmation

vs_A0: paired user bootstrap 95% CI of (HR@8 - A0 HR@8) has lower bound > 0
confirmation_on_test.vs_A1: the learned candidate also needs a paired 95% CI lower bound > 0 for (HR@8 - A1 HR@8); otherwise the extra complexity is not justified and A1 is kept

if_not_confirmed: deploy the conservative fallback A1; no other model is promoted because of test results
latency: no latency SLO exists for this project; measured costs are reported, not used as a gate
